caption: What you get
heading: Four reasons to use Roi UI
description: Each component is ready to use, easy to change, and works for everyone.

cards.alt: Stone arches and cypress trees under a night sky with a crescent moon
cards.title: Accessible by default
cards.description: Every component works with a keyboard and a screen reader. You do not need extra setup.

cards.alt: A white city of temples and gardens under a bright blue sky
cards.title: You own the code
cards.description: You copy the source into your project. You can change any part of it.

cards.alt: Stone columns and terraces covered in cypress trees and flowers
cards.title: Two ways to style
cards.description: Choose CSS Modules or Tailwind. Both versions look and work the same.

cards.alt: White stone arches rising over a green forest pond under a blue sky
cards.title: Motion with a purpose
cards.description: Animations show what changed and where to look. They stay small, so they never slow you down.
